facts.function: network security: one-way data transfer (data diode), keyboard/computer switching, data pump software
facts.form: set of devices and software for computer network security

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8517 covers apparatus for transmission or reception of data in a network; chapter 84 note 6(D)(ii) removes such network apparatus from heading 8471
GRI 3(b): set of devices in different headings (8517, 8537 KVM switch, software); the data diode gives the essential character
GRI 6: 8517.62 machines for reception, conversion and transmission of data

rejected_alternatives.reason: L81485 placed a network security sensor here, but chapter 84 note 6(D)(ii) excludes network communication apparatus
KVM-type switch (L82285) is only a secondary component
a data diode device is a network appliance, not a discrete semiconductor

missing_facts: whether the products are imported together as a set
whether the diode is a network transmission device or an ADP unit
classification.rationale: The data diode passes data one way across a network boundary, so it is network apparatus of 8517.62 under note 6(D)(ii). 963250 (in force) treated network data switching equipment under 8517. L81485 (in force, 2005) used 8471.80.90 and stays as the arguable alternative.
